rows.grounds: locative absolute expression indicating the passing of half a watch; internal sandhi within the compound
denotes the time period in which the action is situated
compound of sādhaka (practitioner) and uttama (best), referring to the foremost adept

items.question: At what point in the night must the foremost practitioner be situated for the practice?
premises: Half a watch of the night has passed.
The time specified is within the night.
The foremost practitioner is the subject at this time.
items.inference: The foremost practitioner is situated when half a watch of the night has passed.
uncertainties: The specific action of the practitioner is not stated in this verse and depends on following context.
items.plain_english: Indeed, when half a watch of the night has passed, the foremost practitioner...
